generate_difference_report: generate a difference report comparing two benchmark JSON runs with optional U-test and color output
filter_benchmark: filter benchmark JSON results by regex family pattern and optionally replace matched names
calculate_change: calculate the decimal percentage change between an old and new benchmark value
get_unique_benchmark_names: get all unique benchmark names from a benchmark JSON object while preserving insertion order
calc_utest: run a Mann-Whitney U test on CPU and real timing data from two benchmark partitions
